That is a points-on-a-variety-in-subgroups statement; fixing x1 gives a curve in H x H, and Stepanov-method bounds (Garcia-Voloch 1988 |G cap (G+mu)|<=4|G|^{2/3}; Heath-Brown-Konyagin 2000; Corvaja-Zannier point counts on P(x,y)=0 with x,y in cosets of G, |G|<p^{3/4}, arXiv 1504.01354 Thm 2; Vyugin-Shkredov) give |H|^{2/3} per curve, hence ~|H|^{5/3} total, without BGK or exponential sums. So the stated mechanism (BGK character expansion) is mis-attributed and the conclusion is likely a corollary of published Stepanov bounds. Also INCBARRIER2 Thm C bars only moment/norm family for generic F; subgroup H is exactly the non-generic family, so the wall hypotheses do fail, but the crossing is cheap.
